torch_fp16_onnx.use: lightweight GPU/NPU inference, parity-verified vs fp32

notes: Keras MobileNetV3Small must use include_preprocessing=False: to_model_input already scales to [-1,1]; double preprocessing collapses inputs to a near-constant range (val collapse to majority class).

ORT static int8 PTQ on the torch model collapses (val ~0.34) due to conv1 activation outliers (max ~200 vs p99 ~6) on OOD ultrasound; production fix is QAT (see scripts/train_qat_imaging.py, trains to ~0.915) or TFLite path above.
Torch eager QAT int8 cannot export to ONNX (quantized::batch_norm2d unsupported at all opsets); BN-folded retrain diverges on this dataset.
TFLite int8 validation requires BUILTIN_REF resolver in this env (XNNPACK int8 delegate fails to init).
